description: Style rules of the workbook's sheets (#706, #708). check_sheet_style.py checks the template against them, and the sheet review of the quick Excel run (tools/Verify-SACCR-Branch.ps1 -Quick) checks the workbook Excel shows, after Clear outputs and after a run. Each role of docs/workbook/protection.json has one tab color, as RRGGBB. header_rows lists the table-header rows of each sheet: every header cell is bold, white, header_font_size points (or the size header_size_exceptions gives it), on header_fill, and its row is tall enough for its wrapped text. A header row is a row number or the workbook name of a cell on it, which follows the row when it moves (#756); a header_size_exceptions key is a cell or NAME:COLUMN, the column on the row of the name.
